test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The patient was devoid ________ any hope of recovery.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**of**" is used to indicate possession or association.
 
• In this context, "**devoid of**" is the correct phrase to describe the absence of something (in this case, hope of recovery).
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **4** are incorrect because they do not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The patient was devoid **of**__ any hope of recovery."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in"** is incorrect as "devoid in" is not a valid phrase.
 
• **Option 2: "with"** is incorrect because "devoid" does not collocate with "with."
 
• **Option 4: "at"** is incorrect as it does not make sense in this context.
